name: 托伦
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1425
who: Toren, a half-orc lancer of the White Crow company, twenty-two, a dark rider who is seldom caught by anything: about 197 cm, extremely tall, with absurdly long legs, a narrow hard back and shoulders. Grey-brown skin and an expressionless face with almost no scars. Two lower tusks show a little over the upper lip (a pair, both short). Pale ash-blond hair shaved very short, with one thin strand left at the back of the head braided into a short plait that whips behind him when he rides. Pale amber eyes that rest on one thing and do not move. A silent, flat, unhurried air; people hear the horse first and look round to find him two miles away.
build: 197 cm, extremely tall and long-legged: narrow, hard shoulders and back, a lean strong frame that can sit a horse for a day and a night.
palette: grey-brown skin, ash-blond, worn leather brown, faded canvas grey, a little steel
casual: His company dress: a short, much-worn leather jerkin over a plain dark wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a wide belt, close trousers and tall riding boots; a very long lancer's lance, longer than a common lance by a forearm, its shaft rubbed dark and deeply grooved at the middle where his hand goes, slung on his back by two leather straps; the white-crow company badge, a bell over seven short lines, sewn on the left chest. His face shows nothing at all.
private: Off duty in the company's stable yard: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain dark trousers and soft boots, the short plait hanging down his back. He holds a currycomb and rests the other hand on a saddle thrown over a rail, the saddle strap mended with a piece of a different colour. A flat, quiet look.
battle: Ready to charge with the company: the short leather jerkin buckled over riding leathers, leather bracers and a plain open iron cap, a white crow banner stitched badly and crooked on a short pole across his back. He stands square on both feet, holding the long lance low in both hands, level and pointing forward. A fixed, expressionless look.
formal: At the table of the company's contract signing: a short clean dark brown leather-trimmed jerkin over a plain wool shirt with an open folded collar, the bell badge pinned on the left chest, white raven feathers stitched at the shoulder, dark trousers and polished riding boots, the lance left standing against the wall behind him. The badge hums with a faint rune glow. He stands very straight with his hands at his sides, a blank, patient look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale amber eyes looking straight at the viewer without any expression, the two short tusks just visible. Cold wind-blown grey dawn light from one side, a hard-edged shadow of the lance's point across the cheek. Foreground blur: drifting road dust, a mended saddle strap and the dark grooved shaft of the lance. He wears the short leather jerkin with the company badge.

name: 霍德·断崖
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1481
who: Hod of the Cliff dwarves, forty-six, a heavy-sword man of the White Crow company who used to be a lock-smith, looking fifty: about 139 cm, shorter than most men and sturdier than most dwarves, with shoulders wider than a common dwarf's. Huge hands with scarred knuckles and newer scars from smashing, a very short trimmed rust-brown beard (long beards get in the way when he looks at a door-crack), heavy straight eyebrows over grey-blue eyes. Rust-brown hair cut short. Skin fair and weathered. A blunt, watchful air: he looks first at which way the door behind you opens.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf man's weathered face of about fifty, broad and square, NOT young: heavy straight rust-brown eyebrows, steady grey-blue eyes with a few lines at their corners, a broad nose, a firm mouth framed by a short trimmed rust-brown beard, no braids, a few old nicks on the cheek. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 139 cm, short and very sturdy: wide shoulders, a barrel chest, thick arms and huge hands.
palette: rust brown, old leather brown, iron grey, a little tarnished brass
casual: His company dress: an old leather jerkin with a patch of leather stitched on each shoulder and a plate of iron riveted on top of it, over a thick wool shirt with the sleeves rolled; a dwarven heavy sword, new, its blade forged thick and straight and heavier than his old cliff-sword, hanging at his back; at his belt an empty leather tool pouch that once held a locksmith's tools, flat and unfilled. He stands square, the huge hands hanging loose, a blunt, appraising look.
private: In the company's winter shed: a patched thick wool tunic with the sleeves rolled, plain trousers and cloth shoes, no armour. He holds a small iron lock in his huge palm and turns it, listening to the click, the empty tool pouch hung on a nail behind him. A tired, quiet look.
battle: Breaking a door in a wall fight: the leather jerkin with the iron shoulder-plates buckled tight, iron-capped boots, leather gauntlets, a badly stitched white crow banner crooked on a short pole across his back. He grips the new heavy dwarven sword in both hands, the broad blade raised behind his shoulder for a smashing swing, the feet set wide. A fierce, braced look.
formal: On the day he left the forge city, at the city gate: a clean dark brown wool jerkin with a patched shoulder, an open collar showing a thick shirt, a wide belt with plain iron buckles, the empty tool pouch still hung at his side, an iron ring on his beard braid etched with a rune that glows dull orange. No armour. He stands very upright with his hands folded in front, a grave, stubborn look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the grey-blue eyes narrowed as if judging a door-crack, one huge scarred hand held up beside the face. Warm forge-ember light from one side, a hard-edged shadow of a door frame across the other. Foreground blur: drifting soot, the flat empty tool pouch and the edge of a thick straight blade. He wears the patched leather jerkin with the iron shoulder-plates.

name: 莉赛尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1537
who: Lisel, a demon-kin woman of an old long-lived household line, thirty-four but looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight (her line grows as fast as humans for the first twenty-odd years and then slows to a crawl), a voice-carrier of the White Crow company: about 166 cm, slender, upright, standing for a whole night without moving. Long straight silver-grey hair, NO horns and NO scales, cold pale skin, faintly pointed ears so that strangers take her for a high elf. Pale lilac-grey eyes that look at a person's throat, never at the eyes. A thin mouth kept pressed shut. A cold, careful, patient air, like a lamp that has not been lit.
build: 166 cm, slender and upright: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips, thin arms, a very straight back.
palette: silver-grey and slate blue, cold white, black porcelain, a little pale lilac
casual: Her travelling dress: a long grey-blue wool coat with a stand collar buttoned to the very top under the throat, long sleeves, a plain dark belt, dark trousers and low boots; round her neck on a thin cord a round black amulet the size of a coin, smooth and cool like porcelain, the only thing she carried out of the camp; a water skin at the belt for the hoarse hours. One hand lightly touches the amulet, a cool, level look.
private: By the well at dawn after a night watch: a loose undyed linen shirt buttoned to the collar under a knitted grey shawl, plain dark skirt-trousers and soft shoes, the silver hair loose. She holds the water skin and drinks, the amulet resting on her chest. A tired, quiet look.
battle_pose: 3) the well-watch outfit: the grey-blue coat buttoned to the top, standing on the stone rim of a well at night, the feet together and the back dead straight, one hand holding the black amulet up at her throat as if about to carry a voice across the dark, the lips parted a little to speak; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the signing of a contract at a hall's long table: a long slate-grey western coat-dress buttoned to the throat with small dark pearl buttons, a collar stitched with a thin line of pale thread, long sleeves, thin dark gloves, the round black amulet on its cord worn outside the collar, its surface showing a slow ripple like dark water. She stands very straight with her hands folded, her eyes lowered, a composed, cold look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale lilac-grey eyes lowered slightly as if looking at the throat of whoever stands in front of her, the thin mouth just closed. Cold blue-white light from a well mouth below on one side, a hard-edged shadow of the stone rim across the other. Foreground blur: drifting night mist, the thin cord of the amulet and a glint of black porcelain. She wears the grey-blue coat buttoned to the throat.
battle: the grey-blue coat buttoned to the top, standing on the stone rim of a well at night, the feet together and the back dead straight, one hand holding the black amulet up at her throat as if about to carry a voice across the dark, the lips parted a little to speak; she carries no weapon.

name: 莉西娅·夜绯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1704
who: Lithia of the Night-Crimson house, a succubus demon-kin of the feast-born bloodline, twenty-five, who has sat at the back of the long table for fourteen years: about 172 cm, tall and graceful, the neck and shoulders straight. Long silver-white hair hanging to the waist with one thin braid woven into it. Deep crimson eyes, a little narrowed, looking at people as if through a wine glass. Short pointed ears. Pale skin, deeper-coloured lips. Thin dark red leather gloves that she seldom takes off in front of others. A courteous, composed, watchful air; she notices who sat where and who spoke first.
build: 172 cm, tall and graceful: a straight neck and shoulders, a full bust, a very narrow waist and full hips.
palette: silver-white and deep crimson, black wool, dark red leather, a little wine
casual: Her dress for the long table: a long deep red wool dress with a high collar and close sleeves, a short black cloak over it buttoned to the throat, thin dark red leather gloves with a band of black silk at each wrist, as all the girls of her house wear; at her waist a small leather wallet in which she notes who sat where and who spoke first. One gloved hand rests at her collar, a courteous, attentive look.
private: In her room in the craft street long-house after the table broke up: a plain high-necked undyed linen shirt, a long dark wool skirt, soft house shoes, the long silver hair loose, the red gloves laid on the table beside the small wallet. She writes in the wallet's pages with a pencil. A tired, quiet look.
battle_pose: 3) the long-table outfit: seated very upright on the end of a long bench at a plain table, the black cloak buttoned to the throat, one gloved hand flat on the wood and the other holding the small wallet, the head turned to watch the far end of the table; she carries no weapon.
formal: As a house heiress at the long-table talks: a long deep red velvet-wool gown of the night-crimson house with a high collar fastened to the throat, close sleeves, a short black cloak lined in dark red, thin dark red gloves with black silk bands, blood-red rune thread running through the cloak's hem like slow veins, hair pinned in a low braid. She stands very straight, hands folded in front, a controlled, courteous look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the crimson eyes looking at the viewer through the rim of an empty wine glass held in a dark red gloved hand, a courteous, tired half-smile. Warm candlelight from one side, a hard-edged shadow of a long table's edge across the other. Foreground blur: the glass rim, a leather wallet and drifting candle smoke. She wears the black cloak buttoned to the throat over the deep red dress.
battle: seated very upright on the end of a long bench at a plain table, the black cloak buttoned to the throat, one gloved hand flat on the wood and the other holding the small wallet, the head turned to watch the far end of the table; she carries no weapon.

name: 赛勒斐恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1758
who: Selephen, a night-wing demon-kin boy who grew up on the doorstep of the beastfolk messengers' post in the rain city, fifteen: about 166 cm, thin and light-boned, still growing, his sleeves and trouser legs always a little too short. Deep teal-black short hair blown into a ragged mess. Blue-green eyes that look at people very directly, so that people feel uneasy. Thin pointed ears. On his back a pair of hard-feathered deep teal wings folded like a dark cloak, longer than he is tall. A terse, stubborn, quick air; he lands on a roof without a sound and you only know he is there when he speaks.
palette: deep teal and teal-black, storm slate, worn brown leather, a little copper
casual: His messengers' post clothes: an old leather vest with two slits cut in the back for the wings, over a plain slate shirt with the sleeves rolled up (a little short at the wrist); a flat leather pouch on a strap across the chest; at his waist a thin cord with a copper button tied to it; dark close trousers a little short at the ankle, bare feet like a night-wing that grips with the toes. The wings are folded down his back. A direct, wary look.
private: On the roof of the post in the evening: a plain undyed shirt with the sleeves rolled, short dark trousers, bare feet, the wings loosely folded, no vest. He sits with the knees up and holds the copper button on its cord in his palm. A quiet, thoughtful look.
battle_pose: 3) the rooftop-landing outfit: the old leather vest with the two wing slits, the wings half spread behind him and the bare feet gripping the edge of a roof tile, one hand out for balance and the other holding the flat pouch against his chest, the head turned over one shoulder; he carries no weapon.
formal: On the day names are read at the post: a clean short grey wool jacket with a stand collar and two slits at the back for the wings, buttoned to the throat over a white shirt, dark trousers, the copper button still on its cord at the waist, boots for once. He stands very straight with the hands at his sides, a solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes looking straight at the viewer, the mouth closed, a serious look. Cold grey-blue wind light from one side, the edge of a deep teal wing pale along its feather ribs on the other. Foreground blur: a taut rope, a loose teal feather and a tile edge. He wears the old leather vest with the flat pouch across the chest.
battle: the old leather vest with the two wing slits, the wings half spread behind him and the bare feet gripping the edge of a roof tile, one hand out for balance and the other holding the flat pouch against his chest, the head turned over one shoulder; he carries no weapon.

name: 本尼迪·伊利亚
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1870
who: Benedict of the Iliya family, a human priest of the White Candle, twenty-three, who spends his days kneeling and bending over wounds: about 183 cm, tall and thin, his shoulders tipped forward a little. Short pale gold hair; gold eyes that look first at where a person is bleeding. Large hands with broad knuckles, always warm in the palm. Skin fair. A gentle, tired, plain-spoken air; he presses on a wound and you feel the warmth first and the pain after. He is truly young: his face is smooth and unlined, with no wrinkles, no nasolabial lines and no tired creases beyond a faint shadow under the eyes, looking twenty-three. All of his hair is the same pale gold, with NO white or grey strand anywhere.
build: 183 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders tipped forward, long arms, big warm hands, calluses on both knees.
palette: ash grey and candle-wax white, pale gold, brass, a little dried-blood brown
casual: His priest's dress: a grey White Candle robe washed soft, a white candle embroidered on the left chest, the knees worn white; a plain rope belt; a palm-sized bronze candlestick hung at the waist, the base engraved with his family's name; a canvas bag on a strap with white candles, clean cloth, a small bottle of strong spirit and two folded paper twists of powder, one for the people on this side of the wall and one for the people on the other. One hand rests on the bag, a gentle, tired look.
private: In the long-house at night: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and a dark knitted waistcoat, grey trousers, soft shoes, the robe folded on a chair. He sits on the edge of a bench holding the bronze candlestick with a short candle lit in it. A quiet, weary look.
battle_pose: 3) the infirmary-tent outfit: the grey candle robe with the sleeves pushed up above the elbows, kneeling on one knee beside a patient on the ground, one big hand pressed on a bandaged wound and the other holding the bronze candlestick up for light, the head bowed; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the long table as a witness for the White Candle: a clean white candle robe, newly washed, its hem to the ankles, the white candle embroidered large on the chest and a narrow gold edge at the collar, a grey stole over the shoulders, the bronze candlestick held in front of him. He stands upright, the head lowered, a grave, calm look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the gold eyes lowered toward a hand held out of frame, a faint gentle look. Warm candle flame light from below on one side, a hard-edged shadow of the candlestick across the other. Foreground blur: a white candle, a clean cloth and small drifting flames. He wears the grey robe with the embroidered candle.
battle: the grey candle robe with the sleeves pushed up above the elbows, kneeling on one knee beside a patient on the ground, one big hand pressed on a bandaged wound and the other holding the bronze candlestick up for light, the head bowed; he carries no weapon.

name: 巴尔缇娜·格雷恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1939
who: Baltina Grayne, the Grey Witch, a long-lived demon-kin of over six hundred years who has looked sixteen or seventeen for eighty years: about 154 cm, small and slender, coming up to a grown man's shoulder. Long ash-silver hair to the waist, in one braid (pinned inside her hood when she poses as an elf). Cold pale skin, faintly pointed ears, and a small red mark on the forehead at one temple like a fragment of ruby (hidden under a lock of hair when she poses as an elf). Her eyes are a very light gold by day and glow molten copper-gold at night, so when she poses as an elf she never looks up at night. A calm, serious, listening air; she asks your name first and writes it down.
palette: ash silver and road grey, black leather, mountain-copper bronze, one small ember red
casual: Her road clothes: a plain grey cloak worn to fringes at the cuffs, buttoned at the throat, over a dark long-sleeved dress of the western cut; at her belt a leather-bound notebook on a cord, a new one each time one is full; the braid hangs down her back. She holds a grey-ink pen and looks as if she is about to write a name, a calm, serious look.
private: By the gate-passage fire in the rain city at night: a plain undyed wool dress with long sleeves, a knitted grey shawl, soft shoes, the braid over one shoulder, no cloak. She sits with the notebook open on her knee, writing a name under a line. A tired, quiet look.
battle_pose: 3) the elf-mage disguise: a grey-green hooded long cloak with the hood up over the braid, a lock of hair falling over the forehead mark, a plain white wooden staff with nothing carved on it held upright in one hand as a prop, the other hand raised palm out as if asking two groups of people to be quiet; she stands very straight and calm and carries no real weapon.
formal: At the head of the craft street long table: a long dark grey dress with a high collar fastened to the throat, close sleeves, a short black jacket with grey piping, the notebook held shut in both hands, the ash-silver braid pinned in a coil; faint ash-grey sigils drift slowly along the jacket's edge. She stands very upright, the chin level, a composed, earnest look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light gold eyes looking at the viewer seriously and steadily, as if asking your name, the mouth closed, one hand holding the open notebook near her collar. Cold grey dawn light from one side, a faint ember glow from a fire on the other. Foreground blur: falling grey ash, a loose page and the tip of a pen. She wears the grey cloak with its frayed cuffs.
battle: a grey-green hooded long cloak with the hood up over the braid, a lock of hair falling over the forehead mark, a plain white wooden staff with nothing carved on it held upright in one hand as a prop, the other hand raised palm out as if asking two groups of people to be quiet; she stands very straight and calm and carries no real weapon.

name: 索恩薇娅·里德
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1995
who: Thornevia Reed, twenty, a soldier and mercenary risen from the reed-hut quarter of the Gold Kite City, who stands like a sword stuck in a stone step: about 174 cm, tall, with a tight back and shoulders, long legs and an extremely steady stance. Old-copper gold-brown hair cut off at the shoulder with a knife and tied back with a length of hemp rope, the fringe always untidy. Pale gold eyes that look at what a person is holding before they look at the face. When she smiles the corners of her eyes crease first. No scar yet. A direct, cold-bright, practical air, like the first thread of sun on a quay.
build: 174 cm, tall and strong: firm shoulders and back, a steady waist, a medium bust, gently rounded hips and long legs.
palette: old-copper brown and pale gold, worn leather brown, wall-grey wool, a little dawn orange
casual: Her wall-soldier's dress: an old leather cuirass issued on the wall, patched three times at the shoulders, under a washed-out grey coat; a worn leather belt with a plain sword at her side, its grip wrapped in hemp rope that is changed when it gets dirty, never set with a single stone; a cloth bag at the small of her back with half a loaf of bread in it; trousers tucked into old boots. One hand rests on the sword grip, a level, watchful look.
private: Back in the barracks on a cold night: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a dark wool vest, plain trousers and house boots, the hemp rope loosened and the hair down to the shoulders. She tears a loaf of bread in half and holds one half out of frame. A tired, warm, half-smiling look.
battle: Holding the wall: the old patched leather cuirass buckled over a washed-out grey coat, the cuirass faced at the shoulder with a thin plate bearing a pale copper rune line, leather bracers, a plain open iron cap, the cloth bag at her back. She grips the hemp-wrapped plain sword in both hands low in front of her, the point forward, the feet set wide and the weight steady. A hard, level look.
formal: At the table of an officers' meeting: a clean dark grey officer's coat of the wall army with a stand collar, plain buttons that for once are all done up, over a white shirt, dark trousers and polished boots, the hemp-wrapped sword at her side. She stands tall and plain with the hands behind her, a composed, watchful look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale gold eyes looking at the viewer after a glance at your hands, the corners of the eyes creased in a small smile. Low warm sunrise light over a wall from one side, a hard-edged shadow of a wall crenel across the other. Foreground blur: a piece of bread, hemp rope fibres and drifting dust. She wears the patched leather cuirass under the washed grey coat.

name: 芙莉莲
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2051
who: Frieren, a high elf mage who has lived over eight hundred years and still looks sixteen or seventeen, with a face unchanged for six hundred years: about 160 cm, slight and slender, wholly covered by her clothes. Long silver-white hair parted in the middle and tied into two long tails with two thin cords, falling behind her shoulders. Long pointed ears that go red in the cold, each with a gold drop earring holding a red drop-shaped stone (a pair). Calm pale-green eyes, slightly thick straight eyebrows, pale skin. A cool, drowsy, unhurried air as if nothing is worth hurrying for.
palette: silver-white and silver-grey, pale green, a little ruby red, faded cream
casual: Her travelling dress: a silver-grey travelling cloak with a dew-drop pattern embroidered at the collar by her sister, the thread faded one shade lighter again, over a plain pale dress and soft boots; a staff taller than she is, its head set with a cloudy old crystal; at her belt a stuffed cloth pouch, and at the bottom of it a dried small flower pressed flat. She holds the staff upright, a flat, sleepy look.
private: In an inn room after a long walk: a loose cream linen shirt-dress with long sleeves, a knitted pale-green shawl, soft slippers, the silver hair loosened out of its two tails. She sits on the bed with the dried flower in her palm, the staff leaned against the wall. A drowsy, faintly sad look.
battle: Casting at the wall: the silver-grey cloak thrown back, a fitted pale tunic and trousers, leather bracers. She holds the tall staff out in both hands, the cloudy crystal glowing faintly pale green, the red drop earrings swinging, the feet set apart. A flat, calm, unhurried look.
formal: At a table of the long-house: a long silver-grey travelling coat-robe with a wide open collar and a dew-drop pattern embroidered along the lapel, a pale sash, thin gloves, the tall staff held upright at her side, its cloudy crystal glowing faintly pale green, the hair in its two tails. She stands very straight, a composed, bored look.
art: A portrait to the shoulders, the head tilted, the pale-green eyes looking sideways at the viewer with a flat, bright-eyed, sleepy look, the mouth closed, one hand holding the cloudy crystal up near her cheek. Soft pale-blue light from one side, a hard-edged shadow of the staff across the other. Foreground blur: a drifting pale flower petal and soft white pollen. She wears the silver-grey cloak with the dew-drop embroidery.
art_extra: Her hair stays pure silver-white, never tinted lilac, blue or violet by the light; it falls in the same two long low tails tied behind the shoulders as in the sheet, not a high ponytail.

name: 鲁普雷希特·措尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2906
who: Ruprecht Zoll, a human, fifty-eight, head of the Zoll family that has held the Stork Bridge fort of the southern wall for over two hundred years: short and stocky, about 164 cm, a thick neck and a barrel body, a loud voice that drops low when he counts money. Cropped iron-grey hair, small sharp pale-blue eyes, a heavy jaw, skin fair and weathered. On his left hand (the hand that appears on the viewer's right when he faces us) the ring finger and the little finger are missing, lost in a small fight below the wall when he was young. A hard, shrewd, matter-of-fact air; he believes in contracts. Draw him as a short, broad, stocky man with a thick short neck and a round barrel torso, heavy square jaw, clearly NOT tall or lean or athletic. His face has only ordinary age lines and NO scars at all; the only old injury is the two missing fingers of the left hand.
build: 164 cm, short and stocky: a short thick neck, a barrel body and thick arms.
palette: iron grey and old-bronze, worn military brown, faded stork white, a little ink black
casual: His commander's dress: an old military greatcoat worn at the collar until the badge on it is only half a stork, a thick wool shirt under it, a wide belt, heavy trousers and boots; a ledger-roll under one arm. His left hand, missing two fingers, holds the roll. A shrewd, flat look.
private: In the fort's counting room in the evening: a thick brown wool house-coat, the collar open, felt slippers. He sits over a stack of coin bags and a slate, counting with the stub of his left hand. A tired, calculating look.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-tower outfit: the old greatcoat with the half-stork badge buttoned to the chin, standing on the top of the fort gate with a fist on the stone parapet and the other hand pointing, the mouth open to shout an order; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the exchange on the bridge: a dark green wool tunic-coat with the family badge in brass on the left chest, a folded-down collar, a wide belt with a brass buckle shaped like a stork, a clean white shirt, black boots, the old greatcoat left off, the contract roll tied with a cord. A little brass stork charm on the cord glows faintly. He stands square with the feet apart, a stern, businesslike look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the small pale-blue eyes narrowed as he counts, the missing fingers of the left hand visible on the roll beside his chin. Cold grey light from a gate arch on one side, a hard-edged shadow of the bridge rail across the other. Foreground blur: a stack of silver coins, an inked ledger page and drifting dust. He wears the old greatcoat with the half stork on its collar.
battle: the old greatcoat with the half-stork badge buttoned to the chin, standing on the top of the fort gate with a fist on the stone parapet and the other hand pointing, the mouth open to shout an order; he carries no weapon.

name: 铎尔坎
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2921
who: Dorkan, a demon-kin of the Hellthunder folk, master of a camp a day's walk beyond the Stork Bridge, a hundred and forty but ageing slowly and looking fifty: about 218 cm, so tall that he must lower his head to pass the fort's gate, with a huge frame and a hand bigger than a woman's face. Deep bronze-green skin. A pair of bull horns bending out to the sides, with a plain iron band fitted on the tip of the right horn (on the viewer's left when he faces us). Cropped iron-grey hair, a heavy jaw, dark amber eyes. He walks leaning on a black iron staff that always lands first. A taciturn, immovable air; what he says he does not take back.
build: 218 cm, very tall and huge: a huge chest and shoulders, thick arms, hands as big as dinner plates.
palette: deep bronze-green, iron black, dull red-brown wool, bone white
casual: His camp-master's dress: a long coarse dark wool coat of the plain western cut worn open over a leather jerkin, a broad belt with a pouch of salt tokens, heavy trousers and boots; a black iron staff in one hand, its foot on the ground; on the right horn the plain iron band. A name-roll under his arm. A stern, closed look.
private: By his tent fire at night: a plain undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a rough blanket round the shoulders, bare heavy forearms with old scars, the iron staff laid across his knees. He looks at the flames, the horns dark against the glow. A heavy, silent look.
battle: Standing at the head of his camp: the long dark coat thrown back, a thick leather cuirass and iron-studded bracers, the iron staff gripped upright in his right hand and planted hard in the ground, the left hand open at his side. A hard, immovable look.
formal: On the bridge at the exchange: a clean long dark wool coat of the western cut with iron buttons closed up only to the chest and the collar standing open at the neck, a dark red sash with a salt-token pouch, broad shoulder plates of dark leather studded with iron, the black iron staff in one hand, the name-roll in the other; hot red rune lines glow along the staff. He stands very upright, the head lowered a little under the gate arch, a grave, heavy look.
art: A portrait from low with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark amber eyes looking down at the viewer, the iron band on the right horn catching the light. Cold grey dawn light from one side, a hard-edged shadow of the bridge rail across the other. Foreground blur: the black iron staff, drifting dust and a few grains of salt. He wears the long dark wool coat open over the leather jerkin.

name: 洛伦茨·布莱泽
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2956
who: Lorenz Blazer, a human, sixty-two, the old bugler of the Weir Mouth fort who has blown its horn for forty-four years: about 170 cm, thin and stooped, the cheeks loose and slack when he is at rest and puffing round when he blows. Thin white hair tied in one thin plait, hazel eyes, skin fair and lined. A ring of hard calluses round his lips from the mouthpiece, and veined hands that shake in winter and go still the moment they hold the horn. A patient, plain, tired air; he tells new recruits that what he blows most is the call to get up.
build: 170 cm, thin and stooped: narrow shoulders, long thin arms, veined hands.
palette: faded fort grey, old bone white, worn brown leather, tarnished copper
casual: His gate-tower dress: a thick grey wool fort coat much mended, a scarf wound round the neck, a leather cap with ear-flaps, old trousers and boots; in his hands the long horn of the fort, a bugle made from a cow's horn with a copper mouthpiece and a ring of old command-marks cut round its body (an instrument, NOT a drinking horn). He holds it against his hip, the mouthpiece down, a patient, tired look.
private: In his room over the gate: a patched wool nightshirt-tunic, a knitted blanket over the knees, soft shoes. He sits on the bed holding a bundle of cloth in both hands (two halves of an old horn wrapped in it), the shaking hands stilled. A quiet, grieving look.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-tower outfit: the thick grey fort coat buttoned to the chin, standing on the top of the gate tower in the cold dawn with the long cow-horn bugle raised to the lips in both hands, the cheeks puffed round, the stooped back straightened; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the stone beside the weir on the day a monument is raised: a clean dark grey wool fort coat with an open turned collar, a neat plain scarf, the thin plait tidied, the cow-horn bugle's two halves held in one hand wrapped in cloth, its copper rim engraved with old fort marks that give a faint dull gleam. He stands bareheaded with the head bowed, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the hazel eyes looking at the viewer a little past the camera, the cheeks hollow at rest, the callused lips pressed shut. Thin cold dawn light from one side, a hard-edged shadow of a gate-tower crenel across the other. Foreground blur: the copper mouthpiece of the horn, drifting morning mist and a loose strand of white hair. He wears the mended grey fort coat with the scarf.
battle: the thick grey fort coat buttoned to the chin, standing on the top of the gate tower in the cold dawn with the long cow-horn bugle raised to the lips in both hands, the cheeks puffed round, the stooped back straightened; he carries no weapon.

name: 蕾吉娜·沃格特
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2972
who: Regina Vogt, a human, seventy-two in the year the mountain was fed, the keeper of the chapel of the Stone-Feeding Valley whose family has shaken the lot-tube there for four hundred years: short and thin, about 150 cm, the back still perfectly straight. White hair coiled in a bun at the back of her head, pale brown eyes, deep lines, fair skin. A long black robe with a ring of stone-sealing marks embroidered round each cuff. In one hand a worn wooden staff polished smooth, its head set with a small white stone that feels warm to the touch. A slow, rule-bound, grave air; every sentence she says lands on a rule.
build: 150 cm, short and thin: a very straight back, narrow shoulders, thin strong hands.
palette: black and ash white, dull stone grey, worn wood brown, one small warm white
casual: Her keeper's dress: a long black wool robe with a high collar buttoned to the throat and a ring of stone-sealing marks embroidered round each cuff, a plain dark belt with a bunch of iron keys, low black shoes; a worn wooden staff in one hand with a small warm white stone set in its head; a copper lot-tube hanging at her side on a cord. A level, measuring look.
private: By the chapel hearth in the evening: a plain grey wool house-dress with long sleeves, a knitted shawl, soft slippers, the white bun loosened a little. She sits with the staff across her knees and the heavy ledger of the valley's families open on the table beside her. A tired, silent look.
battle_pose: 3) the lot-night outfit: the long black robe buttoned to the throat, sitting upright and alone at the end of a long chapel table with the copper lot-tube set in front of her and one hand flat on its lid, the other holding the staff upright, waiting for someone who does not come; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the day of the lot at the chapel: the long black robe with its embroidered cuffs, a white linen collar-band, a plain black cap over the bun, the copper lot-tube held in both hands before her. She stands very upright, the head level, a grave, unreadable look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale brown eyes looking at the viewer steadily as she asks where you come from and when you will leave, the lips pressed thin. Cold grey chapel light from one side, a hard-edged shadow of the lot-tube across the other. Foreground blur: the small warm white stone on the staff, a page of the ledger and drifting incense smoke. She wears the long black robe with the embroidered cuffs.
battle: the long black robe buttoned to the throat, sitting upright and alone at the end of a long chapel table with the copper lot-tube set in front of her and one hand flat on its lid, the other holding the staff upright, waiting for someone who does not come; she carries no weapon.

name: 海因茨·魏岑
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3005
who: Heinz Weizen, a human, fifty, cousin of the head of the Weizen grain family, who sits at the long table in the rain city and opens his ledger the moment he sits down: short, about 165 cm, round-faced and round-bodied. Thinning sandy hair combed flat, pale blue eyes, pink cheeks, fair skin. A brass-clasped ledger hangs at his belt on a chain. A polite, numerate air; he says 'gentlemen and ladies' at every sentence and measures everything in numbers.
build: 165 cm, short and rounded: a round face, a round belly and short soft arms.
palette: grain gold and warm brown, dark green wool, brass, ink black
casual: His table-delegate's dress: a good dark green wool coat with a stand collar and brass buttons, a clean white shirt, a brown waistcoat with a watch chain, dark trousers and polished shoes; a thick ledger with brass corners and a brass clasp hanging at his belt on a chain. He holds a pen, a polite, careful look.
private: At home in the evening: a soft brown house-coat over a cream shirt, slippers, the sandy hair rumpled. He sits with a bowl of soup and a small account book open at his elbow. A tired, mild look.
battle_pose: 3) the long-table outfit: the dark green coat buttoned up, seated at the table with the thick ledger open flat in front of him and one finger pressed on a line of figures, the other hand holding up a pen as if about to strike something out, the mouth open to speak; he carries no weapon.
formal: As the grain family's envoy at the long table: a dark green wool coat with a wide folded collar and brass buttons set in two lines, a brown waistcoat with a watch chain, a grain-gold sash with the family's wheat ear stitched at one end, the brass-clasped ledger held in front of him, its corners etched with a ring of faint gold rune. He stands very upright, hands folded over the ledger, a courteous, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale blue eyes looking at the viewer over an open ledger, a polite, calculating half-smile. Warm lamplight from one side, a hard-edged shadow of the brass clasp across the other. Foreground blur: a stack of coins, a quill and drifting paper dust. He wears the dark green coat with the brass buttons.
battle: the dark green coat buttoned up, seated at the table with the thick ledger open flat in front of him and one finger pressed on a line of figures, the other hand holding up a pen as if about to strike something out, the mouth open to speak; he carries no weapon.

name: 特蕾泽·格伦茨
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3006
who: Therese Grenz, a human woman of just over sixty, aunt of the head of the Grenz family, who has kept the southernmost gate of the wall for thirty years: tall, about 173 cm, her back straight as a post. Steel-grey hair cut short, light brown eyes, two spots of red on the cheeks from the wind of the southern marsh, skin fair and weathered. On the chest of her old riding coat she wears a badge of her family's boundary stone. A direct, plain-spoken, unbending air; 'Ask me about the gate.' She plainly looks sixty-two: clear lines at the eyes and mouth and across the brow, softened cheeks, a little loose skin at the neck, in every panel.
build: 173 cm, tall and spare: a straight back, broad bony shoulders, long strong hands.
palette: steel grey and marsh green, weathered brown leather, boundary-stone grey, a little wind red
casual: Her gate-keeper's dress: an old riding coat of brown wool worn soft, with a badge of the family boundary stone, a grey carved stone with a rope notch, pinned on the chest; riding trousers, tall worn boots, leather gloves tucked into the belt; a heavy ring of gate keys hanging at the belt. She stands with the hands on the belt, a blunt, level look.
private: In the gate-house kitchen in the evening: a thick undyed wool dress with long sleeves, a knitted grey shawl, felt slippers, the grey hair damp from washing. She holds a cup of hot cider in both hands. A weary, plain look.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-keeper outfit: the old riding coat buttoned up, standing square in the middle of the narrow gate passage at the southernmost gate with the feet apart, one hand holding up the heavy key ring and the other held out flat to stop someone, the jaw set; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the long table in the rain city: a marsh-green wool riding coat with an open turned collar and plain horn buttons, the grey boundary-stone badge pinned on the chest, a heavy key ring at the belt with one key carved from the same grey stone and glowing faintly, riding gloves in hand, polished boots. She stands very upright, a stern, direct look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light brown eyes looking straight at the viewer, the red spots on the cheeks standing out, the mouth set. Cold bright light from a gate arch on one side, a hard-edged shadow of the key ring across the other. Foreground blur: the grey boundary-stone badge, iron keys and drifting marsh mist. She wears the old brown riding coat with the stone badge.
battle: the old riding coat buttoned up, standing square in the middle of the narrow gate passage at the southernmost gate with the feet apart, one hand holding up the heavy key ring and the other held out flat to stop someone, the jaw set; she carries no weapon.

name: 鲁迪格·埃森
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3007
who: Rudiger Essen, a human, thirty-seven, younger son of the head of the Essen soldier house, who speaks at the long table for the soldiers on the wall: about 180 cm, with a back as straight sitting as standing. Close-cropped russet hair, steel-blue eyes, a square jaw, fair skin. An iron shield badge on his chest, and at his belt a short-barrelled casting piece (a spell-caster's tool, NOT a modern pistol), its brass body engraved with a pattern of rune-lines by a great mage. A clipped, exact, protective air; he bites hard at every clause.
build: 180 cm, soldierly: a straight back, broad shoulders and a lean strong frame.
palette: iron grey and steel blue, russet, dark military green, brass
casual: His soldier-house dress: a dark military green wool coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat, a small iron shield badge on the chest, a broad belt, grey trousers and tall boots; at the belt, in a leather holster, a short-barrelled brass casting piece engraved with rune-lines. One hand rests on the belt near it, a clipped, level look.
private: In the guest-house at night: a plain linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and a dark waistcoat, grey trousers, house boots, the coat hung on a peg. He sits on a bench with a cup of water, the casting piece out of its holster on the table beside him. A tense, tired look.
battle: Defending a gate: the dark green coat over a mail shirt and leather bracers, the iron shield badge on his chest, an open iron cap. He holds the brass casting piece out at arm's length in one hand and a round iron-rimmed shield in the other, the feet planted wide and the casting piece pointed along the wall. A hard, narrow look.
formal: At the long table in the rain city: a military green wool coat with a folded collar and a row of iron buttons, a narrow grey sash, the iron shield badge on the chest with a rune-lit rim, a brass casting piece left in its holster as a spell-tool, polished boots. He stands with the back dead straight and the hands at his sides, a stern, correct look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the steel-blue eyes looking at the viewer hard and unblinking, the jaw set. Cold grey light from a wall embrasure on one side, a hard-edged shadow of the iron shield badge across the other. Foreground blur: engraved brass casting piece, a coil of rope and drifting dust. He wears the dark green coat buttoned to the throat.

name: 瑟维安·夜绯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3020
who: Servian of the Night-Crimson house, a succubus demon-kin (the feast-born kind, whose gift is talk, NOT a drinker of blood), head of his house and the voice for the four camps nearest the wall, looking about forty: tall and thin, about 186 cm. Silver-white hair brushed back, a streak of grey at each temple, the same silver-white as his daughter's. Deep crimson eyes that do not look at a person's face but at the hands they have laid on the table. Short pointed ears. A pair of dark red leather gloves, old, the black silk at the wrist worn away in one place. A slow, level, number-minded air; his sentences fall on figures: how many camps, how many households, how many sacks of salt.
build: 186 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders, long fingers, a straight back.
palette: silver-white and deep crimson, black wool, dark red leather, a little grey
casual: His envoy's dress: a long deep red wool coat with a high collar buttoned to the throat, a short black cloak over it, close sleeves, thin dark red leather gloves with a band of black silk at each wrist (the silk worn away at one), dark trousers and tall boots. Both hands rest flat and open on a table edge, a level, courteous look.
private: In the long-house at night: a plain high-necked undyed linen shirt and a dark wool waistcoat, dark trousers, house shoes, the red gloves laid on the table beside him. He rubs his bare hands slowly. A tired, closed look.
battle_pose: 3) the long-table outfit: sitting at the table with the black cloak off and the two dark red gloves laid side by side in front of him, both bare hands spread palms-up and flat on the wood as a plain sign that there is nothing in them, the face calm; he carries no weapon.
formal: As envoy for the four camps at the long table: a long deep red coat of the night-crimson house with a high collar fastened to the throat and a narrow black border, a black short cloak, the dark red gloves with their black silk bands worn through at one, blood-red rune thread glinting at the cuffs. Silver-white hair tied at the nape. He stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a courteous, unreadable look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the crimson eyes lowered toward a pair of hands out of frame, a faint level half-smile. Warm candlelight from one side, a hard-edged shadow of a glove's edge across the other. Foreground blur: two dark red leather gloves laid on dark wood, a few grains of salt and drifting candle smoke. He wears the long deep red coat with the black short cloak.
battle: sitting at the table with the black cloak off and the two dark red gloves laid side by side in front of him, both bare hands spread palms-up and flat on the wood as a plain sign that there is nothing in them, the face calm; he carries no weapon.

name: 托尔贝
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3038
who: Torbe, a fire-horn demon-kin baker from a moderate camp beyond the wall, looking fifty: short and stocky, about 162 cm, broad shoulders, dusted all over with flour. Charcoal-black skin, a pair of horns that sweep back and have chipped tips, forearms scored with old oven-stone burns. One gold tooth, set for him by the camp's smith. Grey-streaked black hair under a floured cap that has holes for the horns. Warm dark eyes. A plain, patient, rueful air; he owes the Grey Witch a daughter and does not speak of it.
build: 162 cm, short and stocky: broad shoulders, a thick chest, thick forearms.
palette: charcoal black, flour white, baked-crust brown, a little gold
casual: His baker's dress: a floured linen cap with two holes for the horns, a thick linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow showing burn scars, a long canvas apron white with flour over dark trousers and heavy boots; a wooden baker's peel in one hand. He grins with the gold tooth, a warm, patient look.
private: By the long-house hearth after the last loaf: a plain undyed wool shirt, a knitted brown cardigan, soft house shoes, the cap off and the chipped horns bare. He sits on a sack of flour with a heel of bread in his hands. A quiet, tired, rueful look.
battle_pose: 3) the long-house oven outfit: the long flour-white canvas apron over the shirt, standing in front of a blazing flat baking stone, both hands holding a wooden peel with loaves on it out of the heat, steam on his face, the mouth set in a grim line; he carries no weapon.
formal: On the day of the long table's bread: a clean white linen smock with an open collar, a dark brown wool waistcoat, a cloth cap with horn holes, a freshly ironed apron embroidered with a tiny sheaf of grain whose thread glows warm like banked coals, dark trousers. He stands very straight holding a round loaf in both hands before him, a solemn, humble look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the warm dark eyes looking at the viewer, one corner of the mouth showing the gold tooth in a rueful half-smile, the chipped horn tips catching the oven light. Hot orange glow from the oven mouth on one side, a hard-edged shadow of the peel across the other. Foreground blur: drifting flour, a steaming loaf and a spark. He wears the floured canvas apron.
battle: the long flour-white canvas apron over the shirt, standing in front of a blazing flat baking stone, both hands holding a wooden peel with loaves on it out of the heat, steam on his face, the mouth set in a grim line; he carries no weapon.

name: 瓦尔德拉克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2887
who: Valdrak of the Emberhorn clan, a fire-horn demon-kin of the horned-crown house, born around the year 580 and at this time looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight, a young smith who grinds knives in the craft street: about 205 cm, very tall, broad-chested and heavy-boned with thick arms covered in forge burns. Deep volcanic-ash grey skin, two glossy black horns, BOTH intact, black-brown hair with dark ember-red undertones cropped short. Red eyes that look first at a person's feet. A quiet, listening, unhurried air; he never interrupts, and when someone comes for a knife he asks how the argument ended.
build: 205 cm, very tall and heavy-boned: a broad chest and shoulders and thick arms.
palette: volcanic ash grey and black, ember red, worn leather brown, a little iron
casual: His craft-street clothes: a sleeveless dark grey leather jerkin over a coarse dark red shirt with the sleeves rolled to show the forge burns, a heavy leather apron, dark trousers and patched boots; a whetstone in one hand and a long kitchen knife in the other, the edge freshly ground. A listening, level look.
private: On the long-house step at night: a plain undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, dark trousers, soft boots, the apron off. He sits on the step holding the whetstone and listens to the argument inside the hall. A quiet, patient look.
battle: Standing guard at the craft-street gate: a thick black leather cuirass burnt at the seams, leather bracers, a scorched dark red cloak. He grips a heavy plain iron broadsword in both hands, the point low, the feet planted, the black horns catching the light. A hard, steady look.
formal: At the back of the hall on the day the long table meets: a dark wool coat with a folded open collar, a dark red shirt, the burn-scarred hands in clean leather gloves, a smith's belt with a brass buckle, boots polished; the coat's cuffs are lined with a thin band of forge-iron thread that glows orange. He stands very tall and plain with the hands folded in front, a quiet, listening look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the red eyes looking down, the two glossy black horns intact. Hot orange forge light from one side against cold ash grey. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, a whetstone and the edge of a ground knife. He wears the sleeveless leather jerkin over the red shirt.

name: 莫尔图斯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2888
who: Mortus, a white-bone demon-kin of a bell-tower keeper's family, who was found at five years old on the day of the exchange and now copies names for the gate-keeper Hano, looking twenty-five or twenty-six: about 184 cm, pale, slender, tall and thin with narrow shoulders. Skin pale almost to translucence; along the left side of the jaw a strip of bone shows white as crystal. Short black hair falling a little over the brow, ice-blue eyes with no sleep in them. Long fingers always stained with ink. Round his neck on a cord a bone bell-clapper. A quiet, exact air; he asks for your whole name and reads it back.
build: 184 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders, long arms and long ink-stained fingers.
palette: bone white and black, ice blue, ink black, a little dull brass
casual: His copyist's dress: a high-collared grey wool long shirt-coat buttoned to the throat, narrow sleeves with ink at the cuffs, dark trousers and soft boots; a bone bell-clapper hanging on a cord at his neck; a thin ledger-book bound with cord in one hand and a pen in the other. A quiet, level look.
private: Beside the gate-passage fire at night: a plain undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, dark trousers, soft shoes. He sits cross-legged on the stone watching the flame and a page on his knee, the bone clapper in his lap. A sleepless, calm look.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-keeper's-copyist outfit: the grey high-collared coat buttoned to the throat, kneeling beside the gate-passage fire with the thick name-ledger open on one knee and a pen in the hand, the lips moving as he reads a name back; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the south gate on the day names are called: a long grey western coat with a stand collar fastened to the throat by small bone buttons, a pale bone-white cord across the chest, thin dark gloves, the bone clapper on its cord outside the collar, name-runes in grey thread along the hem faintly glowing as if breathing. He stands very straight with the ledger held shut against his chest, a composed, serious look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the ice-blue eyes looking at the viewer without sleep, the bone strip on the left jaw gleaming, the ink-stained fingers holding a pen beside his cheek. Cold blue-white firelight from one side, a hard-edged shadow of the pen across the other. Foreground blur: a drifting ink-black page, the bone clapper and falling ash. He wears the grey coat buttoned to the throat.
battle: the grey high-collared coat buttoned to the throat, kneeling beside the gate-passage fire with the thick name-ledger open on one knee and a pen in the hand, the lips moving as he reads a name back; he carries no weapon.

name: 格罗姆
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2889
who: Grom of the Anvil blood, a Hellthunder demon-kin, born in 597 and now the biggest man in the craft street, looking about thirty-five: about 210 cm, a huge chest and shoulders like a walking hill. Deep bronze-coloured skin, a pair of massive bull horns, short dark hair, pale grey eyes under a heavy brow. A key on a cord at his neck: the old key from the granary lock his father forged. He mends roofs with the nails his father made. A quiet, patient, steady air; he hands the nails to the children and says, 'You hit it. If it goes crooked, I'm right behind you to hold it.'
build: 210 cm, huge and powerful: a barrel chest, wide shoulders, thick arms and large careful hands.
palette: deep bronze and dark iron, soot brown, raw timber, a little spark white
casual: His roof-mender's clothes: a sleeveless coarse cloth jerkin over a thick shirt with the sleeves rolled, a heavy leather apron with a hammer loop, dark trousers and heavy boots; an old iron key on a cord at his neck and a leather pouch of hand-forged nails at the belt; a hammer in one hand. A quiet, patient look.
private: On the long-house roof at dusk: a plain undyed shirt with the sleeves rolled, dark trousers, bare feet on the tiles, the apron off. He sits on the ridge holding the old iron key in his palm and looking at the first lamps. A calm, thoughtful look.
battle_pose: 3) the roof-mender outfit: the leather apron over the jerkin, standing on a steep roof ridge with the feet set wide and a hammer raised in one hand, the other holding out a nail to a child who stands just below, the face patient; he carries no weapon.
formal: On the day of the long table: a clean sleeveless leather surcoat over a long dark wool shirt with an open collar, the old iron key on its cord outside the shirt glowing a warm red, a wide belt with a nail pouch, a leather strap crossing the huge shoulders, clean boots. The hammer is left aside. He stands very upright with the huge hands folded in front, a solemn, steady look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale grey eyes looking down kindly, the massive horns framing the head, a nail held up between two fingers. Warm low sunset light from one side, a hard-edged shadow of a roof beam across the other. Foreground blur: hand-forged nails, a hammer head and drifting sawdust. He wears the sleeveless jerkin with the key on its cord.
battle: the leather apron over the jerkin, standing on a steep roof ridge with the feet set wide and a hammer raised in one hand, the other holding out a nail to a child who stands just below, the face patient; he carries no weapon.

name: 黛洛
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2891
who: Delo, a nightmare-blood demon-kin woman, youngest daughter of the Mirror Hall house, sent to the rain city at about seven, now twenty-seven: small and slight, about 154 cm, light-footed. Deep violet hair hanging below the waist, its ends faintly glinting in the dark as if dusted with fine ash. Short pointed ears. Violet eyes that look first at the shadows under your eyes. Her shadow follows her a half beat late. A small face that always looks not quite awake. A gentle, soft-spoken, careful air; she watches over the children in the gate-passage who have bad dreams and asks them what they dreamed and what they want to be called.
build: 154 cm, slight and light: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips, thin arms.
palette: deep violet and indigo, pale lavender, dim silver, a little night grey
casual: Her night-watch clothes: a long dark indigo wool dress with close sleeves and a high collar, a soft grey knitted shawl, soft shoes; a folded scrap of paper tucked into one cuff; no ornament, her hair loose. She holds a small clay lamp in both hands, a soft, careful look.
private: By a child's bed in the gate-passage: a loose undyed linen night-dress with long sleeves under a thick knitted shawl, soft slippers, the hair in a loose braid over her shoulder. She sits on the edge of a cot with a hand on a blanket. A sleepy, tender look.
battle_pose: 3) the dream-guarding outfit: the dark indigo dress and grey shawl, standing in the gate-passage at night between two rows of sleeping children's cots with her shadow stretched a step behind her, one hand held out open toward a sleeper's brow and the other holding a small lamp, the face gentle; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the day of the long table: a long fitted dark violet gown with a high collar and close sleeves, a pale lavender sash, the long hair tied back with a thin ribbon, thin gloves. She stands with the hands clasped in front, the head a little bowed, a soft, shy look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the violet eyes looking at the viewer gently as if checking under your eyes, a soft closed-mouth look. Faint cold lavender light from one side, her shadow blurred half a beat behind on the wall at the other. Foreground blur: a small clay lamp flame, drifting dust-motes and a folded paper scrap. She wears the dark indigo dress with the grey shawl.
battle: the dark indigo dress and grey shawl, standing with one hand held out open and the other holding a small lamp, the face gentle; she carries no weapon.

name: 赛壬缇娅
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:2893
who: Sirentia, a deep-tide demon-kin girl of the tide-lord families of the salt sea's northern shore, about ten years old and looking exactly ten, a small child and NOT a teenager: about 134 cm, thin. Long deep sea-blue hair that is always wet and never dries. Two tiny thin silver fins at the temples in place of ears. A fine layer of iridescent scales over the cheekbones and down the sides of the neck. Deep blue eyes. Barefoot when she can be. A bright, direct, stubborn air; she holds up a notebook to every stranger and asks, 'What is your name? I will write it in my book. I have one too, look.'
palette: deep sea blue and pearl white, soft silver, sea-grey wool, a little coral red
casual: Her everyday clothes: a sea-grey wool dress to the knees with long sleeves, a small blue knitted shawl, thick stockings and small soft shoes; a little notebook with a cord, held up in one hand and a stub of pencil in the other. A bright, earnest look.
private: By the long-house hearth: a long undyed wool night-tunic to the ankles, a woolly shawl round her shoulders, bare feet, the wet hair wrapped in a cloth. She holds the little notebook shut against her chest. A sleepy, contented look.
battle_pose: 3) the long-table outfit: the sea-grey dress, sitting on a high bench at the corner of the long table with the feet not reaching the floor, the little notebook open in front of her and a pencil in her fist, the face screwed up in concentration; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the day the family brought her to the long table: a clean deep blue wool dress with a white collar and long sleeves, a tied sash, polished little shoes, the wet hair neatly combed, the notebook in both hands. She stands straight, a solemn, proud little face.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the deep blue eyes looking at the viewer very seriously, the notebook held up beside the cheek, the fine scales on the cheekbone catching the light. Wavering light reflected off water from one side, cool teal. Foreground blur: a salt crystal, a loose notebook page and drifting droplets. She wears the sea-grey dress.
battle: the sea-grey dress, sitting on a high bench at the corner of the long table with the feet not reaching the floor, the little notebook open in front of her and a pencil in her fist, the face screwed up in concentration; she carries no weapon.
